# Aridio Silva — Governed Autonomous AI Research

> Official website of Aridio Silva, an independent researcher working on secure, governed autonomous and distributed AI systems. The site documents the SGAEIA research program: Secure Governed Autonomous Edge Intelligence Architecture.

The primary research themes are Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, AI security, Zero Trust, bounded and revocable authority, authenticated delegation, Continuous GRC, Evidence-as-Code, Edge AI, Context Language Models, and governance for autonomous systems. Use the publication pages on this site for canonical open web reading and the infographic pages for bilingual visual research communication. Zenodo records provide persistent citation metadata and archived publications; Medium, DEV Community, and LinkedIn provide distribution editions. Licenses are stated in each linked record; the SGAEIA reference software is distributed under the Apache License 2.0.

## Official website

- [Aridio Silva — Research homepage](https://aridiosilva.com/): Research profile, selected publications, public writing, academic profiles, and links to the SGAEIA program.
- [SGAEIA — Research program](https://aridiosilva.com/sgaeia.html): Public overview of the architecture, research principles, publication series, roadmap, and research artifacts.

## Article 19 — LoRA in AI Agents

Author: Aridio Silva — Independent Researcher, Brazil. SGAEIA Research Series, Article 19, 11 October 2026. Technical synthesis of LoRA efficiency and adapter engineering reinterpreted for AI-agent security, behavioral supply chains, composition risk, multi-tenant isolation, distributed revocation, and non-normative SGAEIA candidate properties. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23300168. License: CC BY 4.0. Copyright: © 2026 Aridio Silva.

- [Complete English article](https://aridiosilva.com/publications/artigo19/)
- [Artigo completo em português](https://aridiosilva.com/publications/artigo19/pt/)
- [Zenodo record](https://zenodo.org/records/23300168)
- [Zenodo DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23300168)
- [Medium edition](https://medium.com/@aridiosilva/lora-in-ai-agents-efficiency-security-risks-and-adapter-governance-e3cbdfb3e588)
- [DEV Community edition](https://dev.to/aridiosilva/lora-in-ai-agents-efficiency-security-risks-and-adapter-governance-lh4)
- [Academia.edu edition](https://www.academia.edu/178742323/LoRA_in_AI_Agents_Efficiency_Security_Risks_and_Adapter_Governance)
- [English cover](https://aridiosilva.com/assets/article19/sgaeia-article-19-cover-en.png)
- [Capa em português](https://aridiosilva.com/assets/article19/sgaeia-article-19-cover-pt.png)

The homepage records are the canonical open-reading editions; Zenodo is the persistent archival record, and Medium, DEV Community, and Academia.edu are distribution surfaces. Discovery metadata does not guarantee indexing or ranking.

## Article 18 — Tracing AI Agent Execution

Author: Aridio Silva — Independent Researcher, Brazil. SGAEIA Research Series, Article 18, 10 October 2026. Critical comparative review of tracing and observability across 13 AI-agent platforms, with a conceptual, non-normative analysis of evaluation and governed evidence for SGAEIA. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23284753. License: CC BY 4.0. Copyright: © 2026 Aridio Silva.

- [Complete English article](https://aridiosilva.com/publications/artigo18/)
- [Artigo completo em português](https://aridiosilva.com/publications/artigo18/pt/)

## Article 17 — AI Jailbreaks

Author: Aridio Silva — Independent Researcher, Brazil. SGAEIA Research Series, Article 17, 6 October 2026. A critical narrative review of jailbreak history, prompt injection and governed authority; a conceptual response–action–effect synthesis, not an empirical security certification. License: CC BY 4.0. Copyright: © 2026 Aridio Silva.

- [AI Jailbreaks: From Bypassing Restrictions to Governing Authority — complete English article](https://aridiosilva.com/publications/artigo17/): From the iPhone to autonomous agents: a historical, technical and educational analysis through the SGAEIA lens. Full HTML text, cover, four figures and 25 numbered references.
- [Jailbreak de AI: da quebra de restrições à governança da autoridade — artigo completo em português](https://aridiosilva.com/publications/artigo17/pt/): Do iPhone aos agentes autônomos: uma análise histórica, técnica e didática pela ótica do SGAEIA. Full Portuguese HTML text, cover, four figures and the same bibliography.
- [Article 17 — English cover](https://aridiosilva.com/assets/article17/cover.png): Visible attribution and PNG copyright metadata.
- [Article 17 — Portuguese cover](https://aridiosilva.com/assets/article17/cover-pt.png): Visible attribution and PNG copyright metadata.

Use the matching language's homepage record as the canonical reading edition. The article's Zenodo DOI and individual Medium/DEV distribution URLs are pending and must not be inferred from the project's separate software DOI. These records describe the intended public edition prepared locally; live deployment and indexing are not verified. Discovery files help compatible consumers find content; they do not guarantee indexing, ranking, citation or adoption by AI systems.
